Show resource records.

## Synopsis

```text
show [catalog[=<catalog>]] [catalogs] [client[=<client>]] [clients]
     [console[=<console>]] [consoles] [director[=<director>]] [directors]
     [fileset[=<fileset>]] [filesets] [job[=<job>]] [jobs]
     [message[=<message>]] [messages] [pool[=<pool>]] [pools]
     [profile[=<profile>]] [profiles] [schedule[=<schedule>]] [schedules]
     [storage[=<storage>]] [storages] [user[=<user>]] [users]
     [counter[=<counter>]] [counters] [jobdefs[=<jobdefs>]] [all] [verbose]
show disabled [catalog[=<catalog>]] [catalogs] [client[=<client>]] [clients]
              [console[=<console>]] [consoles] [director[=<director>]]
              [directors] [fileset[=<fileset>]] [filesets] [job[=<job>]]
              [jobs] [message[=<message>]] [messages] [pool[=<pool>]] [pools]
              [profile[=<profile>]] [profiles] [schedule[=<schedule>]]
              [schedules] [storage[=<storage>]] [storages] [user[=<user>]]
              [users] [counter[=<counter>]] [counters] [jobdefs[=<jobdefs>]]
              [all] [verbose]
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Prints resources of the running configuration in configuration syntax; passwords are masked. Several items may be given in one line.

## Subcommands

### show disabled {#sub-show-disabled}

**Disabled resources.**

Lists which jobs, clients and schedules are disabled. Without a further word all three lists are printed; jobs, clients or schedules limit the output to one list, any other word acts like none. In API mode 1 only the names are printed, in mode 2 the result is an object "disabled" with the lists jobs, clients and schedules.

Deviation from Bareos: odir shows the configured state, so a job disabled at runtime with the disable command does not appear here, whereas Bareos lists it.

```text
show disabled [catalog[=<catalog>]] [catalogs] [client[=<client>]] [clients]
              [console[=<console>]] [consoles] [director[=<director>]]
              [directors] [fileset[=<fileset>]] [filesets] [job[=<job>]]
              [jobs] [message[=<message>]] [messages] [pool[=<pool>]] [pools]
              [profile[=<profile>]] [profiles] [schedule[=<schedule>]]
              [schedules] [storage[=<storage>]] [storages] [user[=<user>]]
              [users] [counter[=<counter>]] [counters] [jobdefs[=<jobdefs>]]
              [all] [verbose]
```

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `clients` | keyword |  |  |  | Disabled clients. |
| `jobs` | keyword |  |  |  | Disabled jobs. |
| `schedules` | keyword |  |  |  | Disabled schedules. |

Also accepts the arguments of [show](#arguments): `catalog`, `catalogs`, `client`, `clients`, `console`, `consoles`, `director`, `directors`, `fileset`, `filesets`, `job`, `jobs`, `message`, `messages`, `pool`, `pools`, `profile`, `profiles`, `schedule`, `schedules`, `storage`, `storages`, `user`, `users`, `counter`, `counters`, `jobdefs`, `all`, `verbose`.

Disabled jobs, clients and schedules:

```text
show disabled
```

Only the disabled schedules:

```text
show disabled schedules
```

## Examples

Two resources:

```text
show pool=Full client=fd
```

Every job resource in configuration syntax:

```text
show jobs
```

One client including all directives at their default values:

```text
show client=bareos-fd verbose
```
